message: Ready to buy today. Heartland posts T75 at $65,950 + $875 delivery. $61,000 for T75 with delivery and setup.

Thanks for coming in ready to buy. I can't confirm Heartland's pricing, but I'd still like to earn your business today. Our list for the T75 with delivery and setup is $68,900. I can bring that down to $65,500 for the T75 Row-Crop, delivered within 150 miles, set up, and walked through on site.
Closer. $62,500 and I check out right now.

I appreciate you being ready to check out today. I can meet you partway: $64,000 for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough. That includes the enclosed cab with A/C and 4WD, ready to work when we leave.
Deal. $63,000 even for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough. You can check out with the offer id whenever you're ready. Thanks for your business!
